title: Server Time
description: Basically a starterpack for servers, adds commonly used tools for servers aswell as omptimization mods.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/233386711e68860e1db861e3f43ef24a3cac70c4.png)

> **Server time is a starterpack modpack made specifically for servers NOT for client side use.**
> 

Adds common tools like automated chat notification; welcome, AFK, ect. The popular simple voicechat mod, anti x-ray and more!

**Since this modpack is very simple and acts like a base for your server, you can add other mods that fit your specs for your server and that adds specific additions that you feel like you're missing.**
![tux](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f34298e631bc83ecae1fa90500a888d7098db8cf_0.webp)
